---
name: New content type request
about: Suggest a content type for Magika to detect.
title: "[New content type] <format name> (.<ext>)"
labels: missing content type, needs triage
assignees: ''

---

<!--
A request is not a commitment: supporting a content type needs samples plus a
detection rule and/or model retraining. The most useful thing you can give us is
a pointer to where hundreds of properly licensed samples can be obtained.
Do NOT attach files that may contain personal, confidential, or proprietary data.
-->

**Format name and extension(s)**
<!--
Examples:
- "Blender save file (.blend)"
- "Valve Map Format (.vmf)"
- "Unreal Engine asset (.uasset)"
-->

**What produces and consumes it**
<!--
Examples:
- "Blender (https://www.blender.org/)"
- "Valve Hammer Editor, included with any Source Engine game on Steam"
- "Any text editor" / "many 3D modeling tools"
-->

**Where properly licensed samples can be found**
<!--
A few attached samples help; what helps most is a source we can draw many from.
Examples:
- "https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/tree/main/testdata (MIT)"
- "Example files shipped with the specification"
- "Any RPG Maker 2000/2003 game; see https://..."
-->

**Specification** (if any)
<!--
Examples:
- "https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/VMF_(Valve_Map_Format)"
- "https://wiki.tockdom.com/wiki/BRRES_(File_Format)"
-->
